name: Zhu Dong
source:
I’m sure you know, it never snows in the south, but I’m willing to make it snow for you!!

Xiaoyu, who’s taking a break from school, suddenly has a strange, electric-wave girl crash into her life—what kind of sparks will this collision create??

What do all the girl’s oddities really mean? Is she human, a vampire, or perhaps some kind of alien or otherworldly being? Nobody knows.

[From [url=https://lynske.itch.io/chasing-winter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我相信你知道，南方从不下雪，但我愿意为你下雪！！

正在放学的小雨，突然有一个奇怪的电波少女闯入她的生活，这次碰撞会擦出怎样的火花？

这个女孩的所有怪癖到底意味着什么？她是人类、吸血鬼，还是某种外星人或超凡脱俗的生物？没有人知道。

[来自[url=https://lynske.itch.io/chasing-winter]Itch.io[/url]]
